# Paddle cases

Canvas: 500 by 500. Paddle: x 0,y 0,width 100,height 20,speed 10 units/frame.

| Starting x | Input | Frames | Expected final x |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Left | 1 | 190 |
| 200 | Right | 1 | 210 |
| 395 | Right | 1 | 400 |
| 5 | Left | 1 | 0 |
| 0 | Right | 50 | 400 |
| 400 | Left | 50 | 0 |
| 200 | Left and Right | 10 | 200 |
| 200 | Neither | 10 | 200 |

Release-to-stop:hold Right for 3 frames from 0 to 30, release, then 10 frames leave 30.
Focus-loss:hold Right,blur the canvas or window,and verify subsequent frames stay fixed.
Visibility:hide the document while a key is held;returning requires a new key press.
Unrelated keys leave direction unchanged and keep their normal browser behavior.
Repeat at a narrow viewport and with 200% text. Edited color/speed must survive save,
reopen and ZIP export. The unchanged starter remains stationary until implemented.

starter.README.md:
# Paddle

Build a keyboard-controlled paddle in script.js. The starter supplies a working
canvas, paddle model and animation loop. Complete its input handlers and updatePaddle.

## Files and execution

Open index.html in a browser without a server. The site IDE uses the same local
files. styles.css fits the logical 500-by-500 canvas to the page.
Focus the canvas, then hold Left or Right. A keyboard with arrow keys is required.
CASES.md gives the expected states; SOURCES.md records the original inputs.

## Input and movement

The black paddle starts at x=0,y=0 and measures 100 by 20. Its speed is
10 logical units per animation frame, matching the original exercise's frame-based
movement. Store ArrowLeft and ArrowRight as booleans. keydown sets the matching
state; keyup clears it. Handle only those keys and prevent their default action
while the canvas is focused.

Each animation frame computes direction = Number(right) - Number(left).
Add direction * speed to x, then clamp x to [0,canvas.width-paddle.width].
Both keys held cancel; neither key held leaves x unchanged. Update first, then
clear and redraw the canvas so the displayed frame matches the current state.

Clear both states when the canvas or window loses focus and when the document
becomes hidden. A release outside the page must leave the paddle stopped.

## Worked cases and completion

From x=200, one left frame gives 190; one right frame gives 210.
The left limit is0 and the right limit is400. From 395 a right frame gives 400.
From 5 a left frame gives 0. Both keys held at 200 leave 200.
CASES.md includes held-key, release, blur and unchanged-starter checks.

Show both directions, both limits, release-to-stop and focus-loss-to-stop.
Explain why key state is read every frame instead of moving once per keydown.
The unmodified starter draws its initial paddle and remains stationary.
starter.SOURCES.md:
# Sources

Original Juni Learning assignment:
https://codepen.io/junilearning/pen/8ccc67de1bc03e5f2c81f78a411adee1
Observed public alias:https://codepen.io/junilearning/pen/bGeMMmp

Original reference:
https://codepen.io/junilearning/pen/f633db1559cc122a943d0a52bcf74ebc
Observed reference alias:https://codepen.io/junilearning/pen/gOMzzdO/f633db1559cc122a943d0a52bcf74ebc

All original HTML,CSS,JavaScript and settings were reviewed on 2026-11-14 and
retained with the official source exports. Both use Babel,no HTML/CSS preprocessor,
no CSS base/prefixer and no external resources or packages.
The starter has blank HTML/CSS and a single task comment.
The reference actually assigns a500-by-500 canvas. Its unused screenWidth 800 constant
does not describe the rendered surface.

These local teaching files are newly authored from the assignment behavior.
They preserve the black 100-by-20 paddle at (0,0),500-by-500 canvas,left/right input
and 10 units/frame. They supply the missing starter setup,clamp movement at 0 and 400,
use named keys,and clear held input on focus/visibility loss.
The original starter MIT notice is retained in LICENSE-original.txt.
The reference export contains no separate license file;its source remains in the
private audit capture and was not copied into these local files.
